what: hir-firewall exceptions an_edit_compiles_again_only_its_instances_and_those_over_its_closures (exceptions.rs:162, round15-test.log) fails with 32 leaks of codegen's walk: code_walk and body_types, keyed by hir-ty-codegen's `Instance` (mod.rs:679), and share/sites, keyed by hir-ty-share's ShareInstance/ShareDef. Each is the edited body's own work (an edit of `plain` runs plain's code_walk again, one of `apply` its share/sites and apply::<closure>), but the harness tells a key's owner by `Storage::ids_of`, and these key types name no ids, so every one reads as another item's. hir-ty-share now has `impl NamesIds for ShareDef` (Fn/VtableShim push the FunctionId, Closure/Coroutine/CoroutineByMove the id; shims nothing) and for ShareInstance (def, then args), uncommitted (tests-misc-front1, crates/hir-ty-share/src/lib.rs). Ask, in crates/hir-ty-codegen/mod.rs: the same two impls for `InstanceDef` and `Instance` (its `def`, then `args: StoredGenericArgs`, which already implements NamesIds through hir-ty's push_named_ids; `checked` names nothing). `ids_of` is read only by crates/hir-firewall, so this changes nothing else. Acceptance: that test goes clean.

history.note: hir-ty-codegen mod.rs: impl NamesIds for InstanceDef (Fn/VtableShim the FunctionId, Closure/Coroutine/CoroutineByMove the id, shims nothing) and for Instance (def, then args). ra clean, not built.
